top_signals.title: Oil Markets Caught Between Iran War Risks and Emergency SPR Releases
top_signals.summary: Crude oil gave back ground on Thursday as traders weighed emergency supply against tentative efforts to reopen talks with Iran. Neither side has taken control. The U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve is delivering barrels, but the reserve is near its lowest level since 1982. Peace efforts have resurfaced, but no agreement has been reached, and the threat to regional shipping and Saudi energy infrastructure remains. top_signals.title: BP Quadruples Profit to Record as War Boosts Refining and Trading
top_signals.summary: BP easily beat analyst expectations of third-quarter earnings, posting its highest quarterly profit, which nearly quadrupled from a year earlier amid strong refining margins and oil and gas trading. BP’s underlying replacement cost profit, the metric is uses for net profit, soared to $8.6 billion for the third quarter, nearly quadrupling from the same period of 2025, the supermajor said on Friday.
